title: Vicarious touch: overlapping neural patterns between seeing and feeling touch
description: This dataset contains 64-channel EEG recordings from people with and without vicarious touch experiences. Participants either felt touch to their fingers or watched matched videos of touch to another person's fingers. It was collected to test, using time-resolved multivariate pattern analysis, whether seen touch evokes neural representations that overlap with first-hand touch. Raw and processed data, code and stimuli are included.
methods_description: Whole-brain EEG was recorded with a 64-channel Biosemi Active Two system at 2048 Hz using 10-20 standard caps. Participants completed 12 runs of four blocks, each with 36 trials alternating between tactile and visual touch. There were 1728 analysed trials (864 tactile, 864 visual) plus 240 target trials that were excluded. The inter-trial interval was 800 ms. Stimuli were presented with MATLAB and Psychtoolbox.
